name: STEPS
description: STEPS is a benchmark designed to evaluate order reasoning capabilities in sequential tasks by focusing on the rationality of next steps in action sequences such as recipes. It includes subtasks for determining the rationality of a next step and selecting the reasonable step from multiple choices.
reputation: A specialized reasoning benchmark that has seen some use in step-ordering and procedural reasoning studies, but is not as widely adopted as major general-purpose benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on commonsense reasoning of action orders in sequential tasks; challenging for zero-shot and few-shot LLMs; prompting lags behind tuning-based methods.
